home.title: NO MORE WASTE — Together against food waste
home.hero.title:
What was going to be
thrown away can still
feed.
home.hero.description: Every day, NO MORE WASTE collects unsold goods from retailers and products nearing their expiration date from individuals, then redistributes them where they are needed.
home.hero.image_alt: Volunteers sorting donated food for the association
home.mission.title: Three actions, one common goal: waste nothing.
home.mission.collect.title: Collect
home.mission.collect.description: Daily collection rounds pick up unsold goods from businesses and donations from individuals and bring them to the storage facility.
home.mission.redistribute.title: Redistribute
home.mission.redistribute.description: Products are catalogued, stored and then delivered to charities and individuals in need.
home.mission.involve.title: Get involved
home.mission.involve.description: Members, volunteers and employees work together to keep the association running every day.
home.volunteering.title: From Paris to the world.
home.volunteering.description: Founded in Paris, the association has expanded to Nantes, Marseille and Limoges, and internationally to Naples, Porto and Dublin. Today, 14 employees and more than 200 volunteers organize collections, delivery rounds and solidarity services.
